title: Which module a Go binary was built from
question: Our vendor shipped {input}/agentd, a Go program. Which module is it built from, which other modules are linked in and at which versions, and was cgo enabled?

fields.module: string: the path of the main module
fields.dependencies: array of strings: every other module linked in, each as "path@version"
fields.cgo_enabled: boolean: true when the binary was built with cgo

flood.why: The symbol table of a Go binary, twice, where the embedded build information is wanted.
